instruction: Take hold of the switchable microphone with teal body and hand it over.

source.instruction: Take hold of the switchable microphone with teal body and hand it over.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the microphone, which was at x = -17 (left half of the table); the RIGHT arm grasped the microphone, which was at x = -1 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left gripper toward the microphone at (-17, -6, 85) and rotate roll -85 degrees to align for grasping.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+13, +13, -9) cm, now 6 cm (horizontal) / +11 cm (vertical) from the microphone

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-17, -6, 85) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper to z=78, move slightly forward, and close gripper around the microphone handle.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+1, +2, -7) cm, now 4 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the microphone; closed the gripper (opening 0.22: holding the microphone)

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-16, -4, 78) opening 0.22; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift microphone up to z=95, move toward center, and orient gripper forward.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+7, +6, +17) cm, now 4 cm (horizontal) / -4 cm (vertical) from the microphone

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-9, 1, 95) opening 0.23; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate yaw -45 degrees and lift higher to z=101 to prepare for handover.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, +6) cm, now 4 cm (horizontal) / -4 cm (vertical) from the microphone

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-9, 1, 101) opening 0.23; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Shift microphone toward handover point near (-2, -6, 101).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+7, -8, +0) cm, now 4 cm (horizontal) / -4 cm (vertical) from the microphone

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-2, -6, 101) opening 0.23; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Slightly adjust left gripper height to z=102.5.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, +1) cm, now 4 cm (horizontal) / -4 cm (vertical) from the microphone

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-2, -6, 102) opening 0.23; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Fine tune left gripper position slightly.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, -0, -0) cm, now 4 cm (horizontal) / -4 cm (vertical) from the microphone

frames.label: turn 8
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-2, -7, 102) opening 0.23; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Raise right arm to z=100, yaw +49 degrees, and move left toward center.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-11, +0, +5) cm, now 24 cm (horizontal) / -7 cm (vertical) from the microphone

frames.label: turn 9
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-2, -7, 102) opening 0.23; RIGHT fingertips (19, -19, 100) opening 0.95; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper closer to the microphone: x to 7, y to -11, z to 108.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-12, +8, +7) cm, now 10 cm (horizontal) / +0 cm (vertical) from the microphone

frames.label: turn 10
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-2, -7, 102) opening 0.23; RIGHT fingertips (7, -11, 107) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, -0, +0) cm, now 10 cm (horizontal) / +0 cm (vertical) from the microphone

frames.label: turn 11
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-2, -7, 102) opening 0.23; RIGHT fingertips (7, -11, 107) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper forward and left toward the microphone handle.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-4, +3, -0) cm, now 6 cm (horizontal) / +0 cm (vertical) from the microphone

frames.label: turn 12
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-2, -7, 102) opening 0.23; RIGHT fingertips (3, -8, 107) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Continue moving right gripper toward microphone handle at (0, -4, 107).
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-3, +3, +1) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +1 cm (vertical) from the microphone

frames.label: turn 13
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-3, -6, 102) opening 0.29; RIGHT fingertips (1, -5, 107) opening 0.74; table z = 74
frames.plan: Fine-adjust right gripper position and yaw to enclose the microphone handle.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +1, +1) cm, now 2 cm (horizontal) / +1 cm (vertical) from the microphone

frames.label: turn 14
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-3, -6, 103) opening 0.24; RIGHT fingertips (0, -4, 108) opening 0.75; table z = 74
frames.plan: Close right gripper to grasp the microphone.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips stayed in place, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +1 cm (vertical) from the microphone; closed the gripper (opening 0.31: holding the microphone)

frames.label: turn 15
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-3, -6, 103) opening 0.25; RIGHT fingertips (0, -4, 108) opening 0.31; table z = 74
frames.plan: Open left gripper to release the microphone.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 5 cm (horizontal) / -5 cm (vertical) from the microphone; opened the gripper

frames.label: turn 16
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-3, -6, 103) opening 0.92; RIGHT fingertips (0, -4, 108) opening 0.29; table z = 74
frames.plan: Retreat left gripper away to the left and back.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-3, -1, -0) cm, now 8 cm (horizontal) / -5 cm (vertical) from the microphone

frames.label: turn 17
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-7, -7, 102) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (0, -5, 108) opening 0.29; table z = 74
frames.plan: Continue retracting left gripper away from handover zone.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-2, -3, -0) cm, now 11 cm (horizontal) / -5 cm (vertical) from the microphone

frames.label: turn 18
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-8, -10, 102) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (0, -5, 108) opening 0.29; table z = 74
frames.plan: Retract left arm slightly and settle right arm to conclude handover.
